system.description:
A gun-for-hire in Mournas — no loyalties, variable jobs, survival instincts.

  • Stubborn: When Grit activates, recover 1d6 HP rather than stabilising at exactly 1 HP — enough to matter, not enough to feel like a free heal.
  • Shadow Work: Advantage on checks negotiating payment, identifying potential employers, and on checks evading official attention in Mournas.
